item.title: Cailar & Calra
item.description:
Product Overview

In Taiwan, there is a growing emphasis on art education, yet a significant gap in students’ understanding and exploration of color concepts. Cailar & Carla aimed to bridge this gap by creating an interactive learning product to introduce elementary students to the fundamentals of color theory.

Cailar & Carla is an interactive color learning product designed for elementary students (ages 7–11) to explore color theory through hands-on play. By integrating a plush tactile controller and an accompanying physical picture book with a gamified mobile app, children can capture colors from their real-world environment to solve challenges. This multimodal approach addresses the lack of engaging, depth-oriented color education in current curriculums.

item.title: Ocean
item.description:
Product Overviews

In modern society, phone notifications frequently disrupt our concentration and can even affect our emotional well-being. This constant stream of alerts not only diverts our attention but also results in decreased productivity. Conversely, missing important messages often leads to feelings of anxiety. Therefore, it is essential to find an effective way to achieve balance.

Ocean is an interactive device that helps users reduce anxiety caused by notification interruptions, enabling a more focused and mindful experience while they can receive important messages.

item.title: Slime Strategy
item.description:
Product Overview

Many strategy games on the market either require significant time investment or are overly simplistic. As a result, people with limited time often choose other game genres for relaxation, leading them to avoid strategy games altogether.

Slime Strategy is a strategy game that combines a compelling storyline with easy accessibility, allowing players to learn the game mechanics in just 5 minutes and complete it within a total playtime of 30 minutes.
